title: refactor: structure visible and enforced
desiredOutcome: The module structure is written in one place, generated into the guide, and breaks the build when violated: _deps.py holds the layer table and lints the real import graph (no cycles, no upward edges, no unassigned file, hooks import nothing from scripts); the guide's module map is generator output under a drift lint; every script has a tree entry and a section, enforced; every big file is navigable by headers, enforced; CONTRIBUTING carries the add-a-script checklist and the decision record (folders declined with a revisit trigger at 40+ files, usage_ledger split deferred with its trigger, typing ban rationale).

tasks.title: _deps.py: the layer table and the import-graph lint
tasks.description: New flat module in house style (safe_stdio, N/M selftest). LAYERS as data: L0 _output,_ui_theme,_loader,_fmt,_manifest_io / L1 _areas,_policy,usage_ledger / L2 _help / L3 _panel_settings,_panel_ui,_panel_discovery,_report_html,_report_ui / L4 _panel_state,_report_usage / L5 _panel_write / L6 the twelve entry points - derive the true edges from real imports first and adjust the table to reality, the inventory is the starting truth. AST-walk scripts/*.py flat (mirror _output's scanners): sibling import edges. Assert: acyclic; every edge points to a strictly lower layer; every .py is assigned a layer (a new file without one is a named red - the folder without folders); hooks/*.py carry no static import of any scripts module. Selftest: green on the real tree + named fixture cases (cycle, upward edge, unassigned file, hook importing scripts), each mutation-proven.

add: _deps: real tree acyclic + layered + fully assigned; fixture cases each named

tasks.title: generated module map + drift lint in the guide

add: map drift: the guide's fenced block equals _deps --render output

tasks.title: guide completeness + enumeration lint
